title: T6 resolver passes GraphQL ID strings to BIGINT columns; asyncpg DataError
description:
framework/graphql/server.py _make_query_resolver / _make_mutation_resolver pass args verbatim to build_select/build_mutation, and the resulting params list contains Python str (because GraphQL ID inputs always coerce to str). asyncpg then rejects the bind because users.id / teams.id / users.team_id are BIGINT.

Reproducer (live container):
  curl -X POST http://localhost:4000/graphql/ -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    -d '{"query":"{ getUser(id:\"1\"){ id name teamId } }"}'
  -> {"data":{"getUser":null},"errors":[{"message":"None",...}]}

Server log shows asyncpg.exceptions.DataError: invalid input for query argument $1: '1' ('str' object cannot be interpreted as an integer).

Fix options (T6 scope):
1. Resolver-side coercion: inspect column type and cast str->int for BIGINT.
2. Builder-side cast: emit '$1::bigint' when the postgres column is BIGINT.
3. Loader-side schema metadata: surface column types in TableMapping and let the resolver coerce.

Discovered while writing vkr-owp.7 integration tests (tests/integration/test_graphql_endpoint.py). Those 3 tests will start passing once this bug is fixed.
close_reason: Fixed: framework/graphql/server.py adds _coerce_args helper that converts numeric-looking str values to int before SQL params bind. asyncpg now accepts the int8 BIGINT bind. Live curl /graphql/getUser(id:'1') returns {id:'1',name:'user-1',teamId:'1'}; updateUserName mutation persists; listUsersByTeam returns 100 users. Removed xfail markers from tests/integration/test_graphql_endpoint.py.
